sloka: अस्य यज्ञस्य जातो ऽन्तः सामिषं भोजनं मम ।दीयतामिह शीघ्रं वै नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।। ७.६५.२१ ॥
transliteration: asya yajñasya jāto 'ntaḥ sāmiṣaṁ bhojanaṁ mama ।dīyatāmiha śīghraṁ vai nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।। 7.65.21 ॥

translations.english: The demon, disguised as Vasiṣṭha, demanded that since the sacrifice had concluded, meat-laden food should be given to him quickly without any further deliberation.
